title: German Beef Hash
description: A hearty German-inspired beef hash with crispy potatoes and onions.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef mixture and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced potatoes and onions to the skillet and cook until the potatoes start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the beef is cooked through.
Serve the German beef hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
